title: 通知·告示·备忘录·便条
desc: 通知、告示招募、备忘录与失物招领四大类的正式句式，并含标题居中、四行头、落款等格式要点。

entries.en: NOTICE
entries.example:
NOTICE
A Lecture on English Writing Techniques
entries.exampleZh:
通知
关于英语写作技巧的讲座
entries.note: 通知标题居中大写，可另起一行点题。通知不需要称呼与书信落款，勿加Dear与Yours。

entries.en: Attention, Please!
entries.example: Attention, Please! All the members of the Students' Union are requested to attend the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 请注意！学生会全体成员请参加本次会议。
entries.note: 通知正文开头引起注意，多用于张贴或口头通知；更正式公文宜用This is to notify。

entries.en: This is to notify all the students that ___.
entries.example: This is to notify all the students that the library will be closed for renovation from December 1 to December 5.
entries.exampleZh: 特此通知全体同学，图书馆将于12月1日至12月5日闭馆装修。
entries.note: 通知第1句点明事项。notify sb that从句用陈述语序，勿写notify all the students the news。

entries.en: We are pleased to inform you that ___.
entries.example: We are pleased to inform you that a welcome party will be held for the freshmen next Friday evening.
entries.exampleZh: 我们很高兴地通知您，下周五晚上将为新生举办欢迎晚会。
entries.note: 通知第1句，用于宣布好消息。inform sb that不可写成inform sb of that。

entries.en: We regret to inform you that ___.
entries.example: We regret to inform you that the lecture scheduled for Friday has been cancelled owing to unforeseen circumstances.
entries.exampleZh: 我们遗憾地通知您，原定于周五举行的讲座因突发情况已取消。
entries.note: 通知第1句，用于宣布取消或变更。regret to do意为“遗憾地要做”，与regret doing不同。

entries.en: A lecture on ___ will be held in ___ at ___ on ___.
entries.zh: 一场关于___的讲座将于___（日）___（时刻）在___举行。
entries.example: A lecture on Western Culture will be held in the Main Lecture Hall at 2:00 p.m. on November 20, 2025.
entries.exampleZh: 一场关于西方文化的讲座将于2025年11月20日下午2点在主报告厅举行。
entries.note: 通知正文说明活动时间地点。英语顺序为地点由小到大、时间由点到日，勿按中文语序硬译。

entries.en: All are welcome to attend.
entries.example: The lecture is open to all students, and all are welcome to attend.
entries.exampleZh: 该讲座面向全体学生开放，欢迎大家参加。
entries.note: 通知正文末欢迎语。welcome此处为形容词，attend后直接接活动名，勿加to。

entries.en: Those who are interested are requested to sign up at ___ before ___.
entries.zh: 有兴趣者请于___之前到___报名。
entries.example: Those who are interested are requested to sign up at the Students' Union office before November 18.
entries.exampleZh: 有兴趣者请于11月18日之前到学生会办公室报名。
entries.note: 通知正文报名要求。who引导定语从句修饰those，be requested to为礼貌被动表达。

entries.en: Everyone concerned is requested to attend the meeting on time.
entries.zh: 请相关人员准时出席本次会议。
entries.example: Everyone concerned is requested to attend the meeting on time.
entries.exampleZh: 请相关人员准时出席本次会议。
entries.note: 通知正文出席要求。concerned作后置定语，on time表“准时”，勿与in time（及时）混淆。

entries.en: Attendance is compulsory for all members of the Students' Union.
entries.zh: 学生会全体成员必须出席。
entries.example: Attendance is compulsory for all members of the Students' Union.
entries.exampleZh: 学生会全体成员必须出席。
entries.note: 通知正文纪律要求。compulsory比necessary更强调“必须”，注意拼写勿写成compulsary。

entries.en: For further information, please contact ___.
entries.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请联系___。
entries.example: For further information, please contact Li Ming at 12345678 or liming@example.com.
entries.exampleZh: 欲了解更多信息，请拨打12345678或发邮件至liming@example.com联系李明。
entries.note: 通知倒数第2句提供联系方式。contact后直接接人，勿写contact with sb。

entries.en: The Students' Union
entries.example:
The Students' Union
November 15, 2025
entries.exampleZh:
学生会
2025年11月15日
entries.note: 通知落款：发布单位与日期分列正文右下方，单位在上日期在下；日期写November 15, 2025或15th November, 2025。

entries.en: Volunteers Wanted
entries.example: Volunteers Wanted for the International Culture Festival
entries.exampleZh: 国际文化节招募志愿者
entries.note: 告示标题用名词短语，醒目、首字母大写、不加句号，比A Notice about Recruiting Volunteers简洁。

entries.en: We are now recruiting ___.
entries.example: We are now recruiting twenty volunteers for the upcoming International Culture Festival.
entries.exampleZh: 我们现为即将举办的文化节招募二十名志愿者。
entries.note: 招募告示第1句。recruit为及物动词，后直接接人或岗位，勿写recruit for volunteers。

entries.en: Applicants are expected to be ___.
entries.example: Applicants are expected to be fluent in English and willing to work on weekends.
entries.exampleZh: 应聘者应英语流利，并愿意在周末工作。
entries.note: 招募告示列出条件。be expected to语气客观，比must be更委婉，to后接动词原形。

entries.en: Interested candidates are invited to send their applications to ___.
entries.zh: 有意者请将申请材料发送至___。
entries.example: Interested candidates are invited to send their applications to the Students' Union office by November 18.
entries.exampleZh: 有意者请于11月18日前将申请材料送至学生会办公室。
entries.note: 招募告示说明申请方式。invite sb to do变被动后to不可省，applications to后接地名或邮箱。

entries.en: Priority will be given to those with previous experience.
entries.example: Priority will be given to those with previous experience in voluntary work.
entries.exampleZh: 有志愿服务经验者优先。
entries.note: 招募告示补充条件。give priority to意为“优先考虑”，用被动语态更客观正式。

entries.en: Don't miss this golden opportunity!
entries.zh: 不要错过这个绝佳机会！
entries.example: Don't miss this golden opportunity to improve your spoken English!
entries.exampleZh: 不要错过这个提高英语口语的绝佳机会！
entries.note: 招募告示末句鼓动语。祈使句适合标题与结尾，但正文主体仍须保持正式书面语。

entries.en: To: ___ / From: ___ / Date: ___ / Subject: ___
entries.example:
To: All Department Heads
From: Li Ming, General Manager
Date: November 20, 2025
Subject: Arrangements for the Annual Meeting
entries.exampleZh:
致：各部门负责人
发件人：总经理李明
日期：2025年11月20日
事由：年会安排
entries.note: 备忘录用To/From/Date/Subject四行头，每行标签后加冒号、左对齐；日期写November 20, 2025或20th November, 2025。

entries.en: The purpose of this memo is to ___.
entries.example: The purpose of this memo is to inform you of the change in the meeting time.
entries.exampleZh: 本备忘录旨在通知各位会议时间的变动。
entries.note: 备忘录第1句点明目的。inform sb of sth中of不可省，to后接动词原形。

entries.en: Please note that ___.
entries.example: Please note that the deadline for submitting the report has been brought forward to November 25.
entries.exampleZh: 请注意，提交报告的截止日期已提前至11月25日。
entries.note: 备忘录正文提醒事项。bring forward意为“提前”，其被动完成式为has been brought forward。

entries.en: I would appreciate your feedback by ___.
entries.zh: 如能在___之前得到您的反馈，我将不胜感激。
entries.example: I would appreciate your feedback by Friday, November 22.
entries.exampleZh: 如能在11月22日周五之前得到您的反馈，我将不胜感激。
entries.note: 备忘录结尾索取回复。appreciate后接名词，by表“不迟于”，勿写before Friday at latest。

entries.en: Attached please find ___.
entries.example: Attached please find the detailed schedule for the annual meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 随附年会的详细日程，请查收。
entries.note: 备忘录随附材料说明。Attached置句首为固定倒装句式，勿写I attached please find。

entries.en: Should you have any questions, please feel free to contact me.
entries.zh: 如有任何疑问，请随时与我联系。
entries.example: Should you have any questions, please feel free to contact me.
entries.exampleZh: 如有任何疑问，请随时与我联系。
entries.note: 备忘录结尾礼貌收束。Should引导条件从句倒装，后接动词原形，比If you have更正式。

entries.en: LOST AND FOUND
entries.example:
LOST AND FOUND
A black wallet was found in the reading room.
entries.exampleZh:
失物招领
在阅览室捡到一个黑色钱包。
entries.note: 招领启事标题大写居中，正文用被动语态说明物品与拾获地点；寻物启事标题可写Lost。

entries.en: I happened to find ___.
entries.example: I happened to find a black leather wallet in the reading room yesterday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 昨天下午我在阅览室碰巧捡到一个黑色皮钱包。
entries.note: 招领启事第1句。happen to do表示“碰巧”，叙述过去事件用过去时，勿写happened to found。

entries.en: Whoever lost it may come to ___ to claim it.
entries.example: Whoever lost it may come to Room 305 to claim it with a valid student card.
entries.exampleZh: 失主可携带有效学生证到305室认领。
entries.note: 招领启事正文。whoever引导主语从句，谓语用单数may come；claim意为“认领”。

entries.en: The owner may claim it at ___ during office hours.
entries.zh: 失主可在办公时间到___认领。
entries.example: The owner may claim it at the reception desk during office hours.
entries.exampleZh: 失主可在办公时间到前台认领。
entries.note: 招领启事末句。during office hours意为“在办公时间内”，勿写in the office time。

entries.en: Will the finder please contact me at ___ ?
entries.zh: 请拾到者拨___与我联系，好吗？
entries.example: Will the finder please contact me at 12345678 or liming@example.com?
entries.exampleZh: 请拾到者拨12345678或发邮件至liming@example.com与我联系，好吗？
entries.note: 寻物启事正文请求句。Will...please为礼貌祈使句式，句末用问号，联系方式用at。

entries.en: I would be grateful if anyone who has seen it could contact me.
entries.zh: 如有人见过，请与我联系，我将不胜感激。
entries.example: I would be grateful if anyone who has seen it could contact me at 12345678.
entries.exampleZh: 如有人见过，请拨12345678与我联系，我将不胜感激。
entries.note: 寻物启事末句。who引导定语从句修饰anyone，could使语气委婉，勿改用can。
